cohort: 127 women who underwent PH out of a total of 157,553 deliveries at Shengjing Hospital between January 1, 2012, and December 31, 2021
finding: Abnormal placentation was the primary indication for PH, and among these patients, most had at least one previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: 94.49% of peripartum hysterectomies were performed after cesarean section.
